state_mapping: Postal admin1 is the BPS province code (e.g. 31 -> JK, 33 -> JT), checked against the GeoNames county parent; historical postal 91/94 scopes predate the Papua splits, so those 250 province links are cleared
consumer_consequence: Indonesia retains 8,054 regency/city-scoped postcode IDs covering 7,966 codes, replaces their labels with open administrative labels and queues 313 unsupported tuples; 3,829 estimates and 7,804 province links remain.
credit: Source: GeoNames, Indonesian postal code dump, 13 October 2026.
